title: Spanish, taught in English
subtitle: 36 free Spanish lessons for English speakers, spanning A1–C2. Start with greetings and learn when to address someone as *tú*, *usted*, or *vos*.
description: This course teaches Spanish to people who already speak English, from complete beginner (A1) to mastery (C2), following the six levels of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages ([CEFR](https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages)). Each level has six lessons, and each lesson brings vocabulary, one or two points of grammar explained in English, an original dialogue or text, notes on pronunciation and culture, and exercises that check your answers as you type.

Spanish is spoken by about 500 million people as a first language, across Spain, Latin America, Equatorial Guinea and the United States. The lessons teach a broadly neutral Spanish and point out where Spain and Latin America differ. Words and phrases marked with a speaker icon can be read aloud by your browser's own voice, when it has a Spanish one; nothing is sent anywhere.

Every lesson was drafted with AI assistance and is awaiting review by a human teacher of Spanish. The dialogues, texts and exercises are original; literary passages are from works in the public domain. A course alone won't make you fluent: listen to and speak with real people as early as you can.

levels.title: Beginner
levels.summary: Your first Spanish: sounds and greetings, saying who you are, numbers and time, family, daily routines, food and finding your way.

levels.title: Elementary
levels.summary: Talking about the past and the future, health, home and town, and comparing things: everyday life beyond the present tense.

levels.title: Intermediate
levels.summary: Telling stories, giving advice, expressing wishes, feelings and doubt with the subjunctive, imagining, and giving opinions at work and in the news.

levels.title: Upper intermediate
levels.summary: Hypothetical and complex sentences, reporting what others said, impersonal and passive structures, formal writing and the variety of the Spanish-speaking world.

levels.title: Advanced
levels.summary: Argument and nuance: connectors, the finer points of tense and mood, literature, professional and academic Spanish, humour and the language of the media.

levels.title: Mastery
levels.summary: At C2, study style and register, translation pitfalls, the language of the Golden Age, dialects and society, rhetoric, and writing with precision.
